questions.question: 12 is related to 235 by certain logic. Following the same logic, 14 is related to 287. To which of the following is 18 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² + 91 = 2nd number.

Now,

For, 12 : 235

⇒ (12)² + 91

⇒ 144 + 91 = 235.

For, 14 : 287

⇒ (14)² + 91

⇒ 196 + 91 = 287.

Similarly, for **18 ∶ ?**

**⇒ (18)² + 91 **

**⇒ 324 + 91 = 415.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of ‘?’ in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

25 + 3 ÷ 9 −14 × 2 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation: 25 + 3 ÷ 9 − 14 × 2 = ?

Now, if ‘+’ and ‘–‘ are interchanged, and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged, then:

⇒ 25 – __**3 × 9**__ + __**14 ÷ 2**__ = ?

⇒ __**25 **__– 27 + __**7**__ = ?

⇒ __**25 + 7**__ - 27 = ?

⇒ __**32 - 2**7__ = ?

⇒ __**5**__.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are given. Find the number on the face opposite to the face showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a64b10f10cb71dd040574b12a3b1e9d408bcf0357549ebff3c189e6bb35a78d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29ab23ec8385f435c9a4b4c094884c3c872cb6ae2597aa93ae5c03945061fc46.png]
questions.solution:
To find the opposite surface of '2', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b55aaa1d98f6263acfcde1665a7df4920b22f72ea418d15d61c57266703eda82.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e0b12f1c3b00f11b9a71e1e7b4903fd5564b907b7cae8cb5a631d38ccb3b973.png] 

From both dices, 6 is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

6→5

4→1

3→2

4 is opposite to 1.

So, **3** will be opposite to 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "3".

questions.question:
If

‘A & Z’ means ‘A is the brother of Z’,

‘A # Z’ means ‘A is the sister of Z’,

‘A ^ Z’ means ‘A is the brother of Z’s father’,

‘A @ Z’ means ‘A is the wife of Z’,

‘A % Z’ means ‘A is the mother of Z’,

‘A α Z’ means ‘A is the father of Z’,

then how is J related to Z in the following expression?

J % K # L @ M α N & Z
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 &
 #
 @
 %
 ^
 α
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Sister
 Wife
 Mother
 Brother of Z’s father
 Father 
 
 

 

Given: J % K # L @ M α N & Z

It means: J is the mother of K, K is the sister of L, L is the wife of M, M is the father of N and N is the brother of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a1c91c5ca9a289a90fa7e0dba03439126ee4899c7dab827363aa17e72d3bfcf.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48be1aeb273e8da19ad138e58052ee1d91d1ec81b9cc8ab24297354acd2c4dd7.png] 

S, J is the **Mother’s mother **of Z.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother’s mother".
